doc: Target size equal to the coarse size: the target texel centers are the coarse texel centers, so the result is the (already unit) input, normalized again. Checks the texel-center convention end to end (an off-by-half-texel bug would blur it). Measured spread 3e-8 (float64) / 3.6e-7 (all float32); tolerance as the other upsample cases.
